summary: Independent verifier approved TASK-0053: CommandGateRunner satisfies the task contract, preserves capability and mutation boundaries, and all required checks passed.

criteria.criterion: `CommandGateRunner` satisfies `GateRunnerPort` (`gate_kind`, `release_ref`, async `run`) and is registrable in `GateRunnerRegistry`.
criteria.notes: CommandGateRunner exposes gate_kind, release_ref, async run, and is covered by a registry resolution test.

criteria.criterion: Exit 0 maps to PASSED; nonzero maps to FAILED with a populated `failure_class`; timeout maps to TIMED_OUT; missing executable maps to ERROR or BLOCKED. Each of the four cases has a dedicated unit test.
criteria.notes: Dedicated tests cover exit 0 passed, nonzero failed with unexpected_exit_code, timeout timed_out, and missing executable error.

criteria.criterion: The command is executed only via `RuntimeProvider.exec`; there is no direct `subprocess` call in the runner, and execution is gated by a `process.exec` capability grant that is default-deny without an explicit resource grant.
criteria.notes: Runner calls runtime_provider.exec and has no subprocess import or direct process API call; process.exec grant absence blocks execution before runtime calls.

criteria.criterion: Command output is written as an artifact and `raw_output_ref` is set on the `GateExecutionResult`.
criteria.notes: Command output is written through ArtifactStore.put and raw_output_ref is set; targeted tests assert both.

criteria.criterion: A command gate that mutates the workspace with `mutation_allowed=False` triggers the existing `unexpected_workspace_mutation` failure path.
criteria.notes: Command-runner workspace mutation with mutation_allowed false still fails through unexpected_workspace_mutation.

criteria.criterion: `DeterministicGateRunner` behavior is unchanged and its existing tests still pass.
criteria.notes: DeterministicGateRunner implementation remains unchanged in behavior and existing tests passed in targeted and full discovery runs.
src/ahra/verification.py imports standard-library modules plus ahra domain modules only; no adapter, model, or cloud dependency import was introduced.

criteria.criterion: Targeted tests, lint, and diff checks pass, or any failure is recorded as a blocker with exact command output.
criteria.notes: Independent reruns passed: tests.test_verification, scripts/check.py --test, scripts/check.py --lint, and git diff --check.

criteria.criterion: Producer moves TASK-0053 only to review; EvidenceGate decides completion.
criteria.notes: Producer moved TASK-0053 only to review at state_version 2; completion is left to EvidenceGate.
